name: Elemental Assault (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 12

Benefit: The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to imbue himself with elemental energy. This functions as elemental aura and lasts for a number of rounds equal to the magus’s Intelligence modifier.
